Every request has one initial non-verifying bootstrap and terminates on a verifier. Two drafts generated per actual verify; no abandoned/error proposals included. Four omitted terminal counters plus four bootstraps exactly reconcile with independently recovered accounting steps.

Done lines are associated with request rows through unique server usage TTFT rounded to 0.1ms. Rounded mean_na and p1 each admit exactly one integer count for the known accepted total. These reconstructed integers are not directly logged counters.

Accepted usage counts accepted seq_len growth before output-cap emission, including accepted positions at terminal verification that might not all be emitted. Proposal rejection here means not in the accepted prefix, not necessarily a wrong token independently evaluated after the first mismatch.
